# Pura Nights — Melitta Siomos Dance Academy

> Award-winning Salsa & Bachata dance school in West London. Weekly classes in Chiswick (Mondays) and Ealing (Tuesdays), private lessons, wedding dance choreography, and the international Pura Ladies performance team.

Founded by international award-winning instructor Melitta Siomos. Beginner-friendly, no partner required. Drop-in from £5; class bundles and monthly Latin Friday socials available.
